initialization_scale_convention: epsilon is the scale of M=WW^T. Gaussian entries have standard deviation sqrt(epsilon/width).
overlap_convention: Individual eigenvector overlaps are flagged as non-identifiable at degenerate eigenvalues. Generator eigenspace comparisons use the normalized projector overlap and carry a separate identifiability flag.
paired_initializations: For each replicate one Gaussian direction is rescaled across every epsilon and transformed into the row-fixed and row-Stiefel controls.
